name: debug_draw
description: Draws a coloured square for every entity that has a Square and a position: the simplest way to see a game before it has art.

components.name: Square
components.description: A square centred on the entity's Position. size is its side in world units; red, green and blue are 0 to 255.

systems.name: draw
systems.description: Asks the renderer to draw every Square, then ends the frame. Presentation only: it never changes the simulation.
